. It has been brought to the notice of this Court by the Investigating Officer, who is present in person along with the case diary that the petitioner is not cooperating with the investigation and,
accordingly, a prayer has been made for dismissal of the instant bail application.

Even the record reveals that on 25.10.2024, Investigating Officer was present in person along with the case diary, on which date, Investigating Officer has apprised this Court that the petitioner is not participating in the investigation and before dismissing the bail application, the Court deemed it proper to grant one opportunity to the petitioner to approach the Investigating Officer, failing which, it was observed that the Court will be constrained to withdraw the concession of interim bail in anticipation of arrest granted to him.

Accordingly, the petitioner was directed to remain present before the Investigating Officer w.e.f. 28.10.2024 to 31.10.2024 from 10 AM to 01 PM by directing the petitioner to cooperate with the Investigating Officer and thereafter, the Investigating Officer was directed to file detailed status report with special reference as to whether the petitioner has complied the conditions imposed by this Court or not.

02. Pursuant thereto, the fresh status report has been filed on behalf of the respondents on 04.11.2024 in which a specific stand has been taken by the respondents that on 31.10.2024, the accused did not turn up and he is not complying the direction passed by this Court from time to time and has also not cooperated with the investigation.

The Investigating Officer has shown its inability to conclude the investigation, as the accused/petitioner herein is not cooperating with the Rajinder Singh vs U.T. Of J&K on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76941240/
1 investigation and has flouted the conditions imposed by this Court while granting the bail in anticipation.

sentences.text: However, on the other hand, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he is fully cooperating with the investigation and the stand taken by the respondents in the status report is false.

03. In the aforesaid backdrop, this Court deems it proper to direct the petitioner to remain present before the Investigating Officer on 16.12.2024 in between 1 PM to 4 PM and is also directed to cooperate with the Investigating Officer with regard to the investigation in question and the Investigating Officer is also at liberty to summon the petitioner on 20.12.2024, same time.

04 . Record further reveals that the FIR No. 51/2020 was registered on 28.12.2020 under Section 420/120-B of Indian Penal Code and the investigation, inspite of lapse of four years, has not been concluded as on today.
The Investigating Officer shall also make an endeavour to conclude the investigation expeditiously.
Respondents are directed to file fresh status report with special reference, as to whether the petitioner has complied the conditions imposed by this Court or not.
In the meantime, Investigating Officer is directed to remain present along with case diary on the next date of hearing.
(Wasim Sadiq Nargal) Judge JAMMU 11.12.2024
